s:
• Erkin jism diagrammasi (FBD): Jismga 3 ta asosiy kuch ta’sir qiladi: og‘irlik kuchi $m\vec{g}$, normal reaksiya $\vec{N}$ va sirt bilan jism orasidagi Kulon-Amonton ishqalanish kuchi $\vec{F}_{ishq}$.
• Kuchlar proyeksiyalari: $$F_{\parallel} = m g \sin\alpha, \qquad N = m g \cos\alpha$$ • Tinchlikdagi va sirpanishdagi ishqalanish: $$F_{ishq,\max} = \mu_s N = \mu_s m g \cos\alpha, \qquad F_{ishq,k} = \mu_k m g \cos\alpha$$ • Harakatlanish sharti va tezlanish: $$\text{Agar } \tan\alpha > \mu_s \implies a = g(\sin\alpha - \mu_k\cos\alpha)$$ $$\text{Agar } \tan\alpha \le \mu_s \implies a = 0 \text{ (jism qiya tekislikda tinch turadi)}$$
ru:
• Диаграмма свободного тела (FBD): на тело действуют 3 основные силы: сила тяжести $m\vec{g}$, нормальная реакция $\vec{N}$ и сила трения Кулона–Амонтона между поверхностью и телом $\vec{F}_{ishq}$.
• Проекции сил: $$F_{\parallel} = m g \sin\alpha, \qquad N = m g \cos\alpha$$ • Трение покоя и скольжения: $$F_{ishq,\max} = \mu_s N = \mu_s m g \cos\alpha, \qquad F_{ishq,k} = \mu_k m g \cos\alpha$$ • Условие движения и ускорение: $$\text{Agar } \tan\alpha > \mu_s \implies a = g(\sin\alpha - \mu_k\cos\alpha)$$ $$\text{Agar } \tan\alpha \le \mu_s \implies a = 0 \text{ (jism qiya tekislikda tinch turadi)}$$
en:
• Free-body diagram (FBD): 3 main forces act on the body: weight $m\vec{g}$, the normal force $\vec{N}$ and the Coulomb–Amontons friction between surface and body $\vec{F}_{ishq}$.
• Force projections: $$F_{\parallel} = m g \sin\alpha, \qquad N = m g \cos\alpha$$ • Static and sliding friction: $$F_{ishq,\max} = \mu_s N = \mu_s m g \cos\alpha, \qquad F_{ishq,k} = \mu_k m g \cos\alpha$$ • Condition for motion and acceleration: $$\text{Agar } \tan\alpha > \mu_s \implies a = g(\sin\alpha - \mu_k\cos\alpha)$$ $$\text{Agar } \tan\alpha \le \mu_s \implies a = 0 \text{ (jism qiya tekislikda tinch turadi)}$$

s:
• Chiziqli impulsning saqlanish qonuni (vektor ko‘rinishida): $$m_1 \vec{v}_1 + m_2 \vec{v}_2 = m_1 \vec{v}_1' + m_2 \vec{v}_2' \implies \sum_{i} m_i \vec{v}_i = \text{const}$$ • Tiklanish koeffitsiyenti ($e \in [0, 1]$): $$e = -\frac{(\vec{v}_1' - \vec{v}_2')\cdot\vec{n}}{(\vec{v}_1 - \vec{v}_2)\cdot\vec{n}}$$ Bu yerda $e=1$ mutlaq elastik to‘qnashuv ($\Delta E_k = 0$), $e=0$ esa mutlaq noelastik to‘qnashuvga mos keladi.
• Noelastik to‘qnashuvda yo‘qotilgan mexanik energiya: $$\Delta E_k = \frac{1}{2}\frac{m_1 m_2}{m_1 + m_2}(1 - e^2)((\vec{v}_1 - \vec{v}_2)\cdot\vec{n})^2$$
ru:
• Закон сохранения линейного импульса (в векторной форме): $$m_1 \vec{v}_1 + m_2 \vec{v}_2 = m_1 \vec{v}_1' + m_2 \vec{v}_2' \implies \sum_{i} m_i \vec{v}_i = \text{const}$$ • Коэффициент восстановления ($e \in [0, 1]$): $$e = -\frac{(\vec{v}_1' - \vec{v}_2')\cdot\vec{n}}{(\vec{v}_1 - \vec{v}_2)\cdot\vec{n}}$$ Здесь $e=1$ соответствует абсолютно упругому столкновению ($\Delta E_k = 0$), а $e=0$ — абсолютно неупругому.
• Механическая энергия, теряемая при неупругом столкновении: $$\Delta E_k = \frac{1}{2}\frac{m_1 m_2}{m_1 + m_2}(1 - e^2)((\vec{v}_1 - \vec{v}_2)\cdot\vec{n})^2$$
en:
• Conservation of linear momentum (vector form): $$m_1 \vec{v}_1 + m_2 \vec{v}_2 = m_1 \vec{v}_1' + m_2 \vec{v}_2' \implies \sum_{i} m_i \vec{v}_i = \text{const}$$ • Coefficient of restitution ($e \in [0, 1]$): $$e = -\frac{(\vec{v}_1' - \vec{v}_2')\cdot\vec{n}}{(\vec{v}_1 - \vec{v}_2)\cdot\vec{n}}$$ Here $e=1$ corresponds to a perfectly elastic collision ($\Delta E_k = 0$) and $e=0$ to a perfectly inelastic one.
• Mechanical energy lost in an inelastic collision: $$\Delta E_k = \frac{1}{2}\frac{m_1 m_2}{m_1 + m_2}(1 - e^2)((\vec{v}_1 - \vec{v}_2)\cdot\vec{n})^2$$

s: // ============================================================================ // 12-ma’ruza: Claude 2D Simplektik Fizika Dvigateli Kodi // ============================================================================ class Vector2D { constructor(x = 0, y = 0) { this.x = x; this.y = y; } add(v) { return new Vector2D(this.x + v.x, this.y + v.y); } sub(v) { return new Vector2D(this.x - v.x, this.y - v.y); } scale(s) { return new Vector2D(this.x * s, this.y * s); } dot(v) { return this.x * v.x + this.y * v.y; } magSq() { return this.x * this.x + this.y * this.y; } mag() { return Math.sqrt(this.magSq()); } unit() { const m = this.mag(); return m > 0 ? this.scale(1 / m) : new Vector2D(); } } class PhysicsParticle2D { constructor(x, y, vx, vy, radius, mass, color) { this.pos = new Vector2D(x, y); this.vel = new Vector2D(vx, vy); this.radius = radius; this.mass = mass; this.color = color; } // Simplektik Eyler–Kromer integratsiyasi (Fazaviy hajm va invariantlar saqlanadi) update(dt, acc = new Vector2D(0, 0)) { // 1. Avval tezlik yangilanadi: v(t+dt) = v(t) + a(t)*dt this.vel = this.vel.add(acc.scale(dt)); // 2. Yangilangan tezlik bilan koordinata hisoblanadi: x(t+dt) = x(t) + v(t+dt)*dt this.pos = this.pos.add(this.vel.scale(dt)); } // 2D Elastik / Noelastik to‘qnashuvni impuls usulida hal qilish resolveCollision(other, e = 1.0) { const diff = other.pos.sub(this.pos); const dist = diff.mag(); const minDist = this.radius + other.radius; if (dist < minDist && dist > 0) { // 1. Birlik normal vektor const normal = diff.unit(); // 2. Nisbiy tezlik normal bo‘yicha const relVel = this.vel.sub(other.vel); const velAlongNormal = relVel.dot(normal); // Faqat jismlar bir-biriga yaqinlashayotgan bo‘lsagina impuls hisoblanadi if (velAlongNormal > 0) { const invM1 = 1 / this.mass; const invM2 = 1 / other.mass; const impulseMagnitude = -((1 + e) * velAlongNormal) / (invM1 + invM2); const impulseVec = normal.scale(impulseMagnitude); this.vel = this.vel.add(impulseVec.scale(invM1)); other.vel = other.vel.sub(impulseVec.scale(invM2)); // 3. Minimum Translation Vector (MTV) Penetratsiya tuzatish const overlap = 0.5 * (minDist - dist); this.pos = this.pos.sub(normal.scale(overlap)); other.pos = other.pos.add(normal.scale(overlap)); } } } }
ru: // ============================================================================ // Лекция 12: код 2D симплектического физического движка Claude // ============================================================================ class Vector2D { constructor(x = 0, y = 0) { this.x = x; this.y = y; } add(v) { return new Vector2D(this.x + v.x, this.y + v.y); } sub(v) { return new Vector2D(this.x - v.x, this.y - v.y); } scale(s) { return new Vector2D(this.x * s, this.y * s); } dot(v) { return this.x * v.x + this.y * v.y; } magSq() { return this.x * this.x + this.y * this.y; } mag() { return Math.sqrt(this.magSq()); } unit() { const m = this.mag(); return m > 0 ? this.scale(1 / m) : new Vector2D(); } } class PhysicsParticle2D { constructor(x, y, vx, vy, radius, mass, color) { this.pos = new Vector2D(x, y); this.vel = new Vector2D(vx, vy); this.radius = radius; this.mass = mass; this.color = color; } // Симплектическое интегрирование Эйлера–Кромера (сохраняются фазовый объём и инварианты) update(dt, acc = new Vector2D(0, 0)) { // 1. Сначала обновляется скорость: v(t+dt) = v(t) + a(t)*dt this.vel = this.vel.add(acc.scale(dt)); // 2. С обновлённой скоростью вычисляется координата: x(t+dt) = x(t) + v(t+dt)*dt this.pos = this.pos.add(this.vel.scale(dt)); } // Решение 2D упругого / неупругого столкновения импульсным методом resolveCollision(other, e = 1.0) { const diff = other.pos.sub(this.pos); const dist = diff.mag(); const minDist = this.radius + other.radius; if (dist < minDist && dist > 0) { // 1. Единичный вектор нормали const normal = diff.unit(); // 2. Относительная скорость вдоль нормали const relVel = this.vel.sub(other.vel); const velAlongNormal = relVel.dot(normal); // Импульс вычисляется, только если тела сближаются if (velAlongNormal > 0) { const invM1 = 1 / this.mass; const invM2 = 1 / other.mass; const impulseMagnitude = -((1 + e) * velAlongNormal) / (invM1 + invM2); const impulseVec = normal.scale(impulseMagnitude); this.vel = this.vel.add(impulseVec.scale(invM1)); other.vel = other.vel.sub(impulseVec.scale(invM2)); // 3. Коррекция проникновения по Minimum Translation Vector (MTV) const overlap = 0.5 * (minDist - dist); this.pos = this.pos.sub(normal.scale(overlap)); other.pos = other.pos.add(normal.scale(overlap)); } } } }
en: // ============================================================================ // Lecture 12: Claude 2D symplectic physics engine code // ============================================================================ class Vector2D { constructor(x = 0, y = 0) { this.x = x; this.y = y; } add(v) { return new Vector2D(this.x + v.x, this.y + v.y); } sub(v) { return new Vector2D(this.x - v.x, this.y - v.y); } scale(s) { return new Vector2D(this.x * s, this.y * s); } dot(v) { return this.x * v.x + this.y * v.y; } magSq() { return this.x * this.x + this.y * this.y; } mag() { return Math.sqrt(this.magSq()); } unit() { const m = this.mag(); return m > 0 ? this.scale(1 / m) : new Vector2D(); } } class PhysicsParticle2D { constructor(x, y, vx, vy, radius, mass, color) { this.pos = new Vector2D(x, y); this.vel = new Vector2D(vx, vy); this.radius = radius; this.mass = mass; this.color = color; } // Symplectic Euler–Cromer integration (phase volume and invariants are preserved) update(dt, acc = new Vector2D(0, 0)) { // 1. Update velocity first: v(t+dt) = v(t) + a(t)*dt this.vel = this.vel.add(acc.scale(dt)); // 2. Compute position with the updated velocity: x(t+dt) = x(t) + v(t+dt)*dt this.pos = this.pos.add(this.vel.scale(dt)); } // Resolve a 2D elastic / inelastic collision with the impulse method resolveCollision(other, e = 1.0) { const diff = other.pos.sub(this.pos); const dist = diff.mag(); const minDist = this.radius + other.radius; if (dist < minDist && dist > 0) { // 1. Unit normal vector const normal = diff.unit(); // 2. Relative velocity along the normal const relVel = this.vel.sub(other.vel); const velAlongNormal = relVel.dot(normal); // Compute the impulse only if the bodies are approaching if (velAlongNormal > 0) { const invM1 = 1 / this.mass; const invM2 = 1 / other.mass; const impulseMagnitude = -((1 + e) * velAlongNormal) / (invM1 + invM2); const impulseVec = normal.scale(impulseMagnitude); this.vel = this.vel.add(impulseVec.scale(invM1)); other.vel = other.vel.sub(impulseVec.scale(invM2)); // 3. Minimum Translation Vector (MTV) penetration correction const overlap = 0.5 * (minDist - dist); this.pos = this.pos.sub(normal.scale(overlap)); other.pos = other.pos.add(normal.scale(overlap)); } } } }

Antigravity continuously audits three key physical–mathematical invariants: 1) frame stability per Glenn Fiedler’s "Fix Your Timestep" ($60\text{ FPS}$), 2) artificial energy drift in a closed system ($\Delta E/E_0 < 10^{-3}$) and 3) Liouville phase-volume conservation:

s: 12.3-rasm: Simplektik Eyler–Kromer va oddiy Eyler integratsiyasida fazaviy portret va energiya saqlanishi auditi.
ru: Рис. 12.3: аудит фазового портрета и сохранения энергии при симплектическом Эйлере–Кромере и простом Эйлере.
en: Figure 12.3: Phase portrait and energy conservation audit for symplectic Euler–Cromer vs plain Euler integration.

s:
1. Delta-time akkumulyatori:
Kadrlar tezligi tebranishidan qat’i nazar fizika hisob-kitoblari qat’iy $\Delta t = 1/60\text{ s}$ fiksatsiyalangan qadamda bajariladi. Vaqt qoldig‘i $\alpha = \text{accumulator} / \Delta t$ bilan interpolyatsiya qilinadi.
ru:
1. Аккумулятор delta-time:
Независимо от колебаний частоты кадров физические расчёты выполняются со строго фиксированным шагом $\Delta t = 1/60\text{ s}$. Остаток времени интерполируется через $\alpha = \text{accumulator} / \Delta t$.
en:
1. Delta-time accumulator:
Regardless of frame-rate fluctuations, physics calculations run at a strictly fixed step $\Delta t = 1/60\text{ s}$. The leftover time is interpolated via $\alpha = \text{accumulator} / \Delta t$.

s:
2. Energiya dreyfi nazorati:
Konservativ to‘qnashuvlarda $\frac{|E(t) - E_0|}{E_0} < 10^{-3}$ sharti tekshiriladi; oddiy Eylerdagi kabi energiya portlashi (divergensiya) darhol ogohlantiriladi.
ru:
2. Контроль энергетического дрейфа:
В консервативных столкновениях проверяется условие $\frac{|E(t) - E_0|}{E_0} < 10^{-3}$; «взрыв» энергии (дивергенция), как в простом Эйлере, немедленно сигнализируется.
en:
2. Energy drift control:
The $\frac{|E(t) - E_0|}{E_0} < 10^{-3}$ condition is checked in conservative collisions; an energy blow-up (divergence), as with plain Euler, is flagged immediately.

s:
3. AST va zero-GC auditi:
Kadr tsikli ichida yangi obyekt yaratmaslik (Object Pooling va In-Place Vector Reuse) orqali Garbage Collection to‘xtalishlari (Jank) bartaraf qilinadi.
ru:
3. Аудит AST и zero-GC:
Остановки сборки мусора (jank) устраняются отказом от создания новых объектов внутри цикла кадров (Object Pooling и In-Place Vector Reuse).
en:
3. AST and zero-GC audit:
Garbage-collection pauses (jank) are eliminated by not creating new objects inside the frame loop (object pooling and in-place vector reuse).

en: A) Because plain Euler code is too long

s: B) Oddiy Eylerda energiya har kadrda sun’iy eksponensial ortib ketadi, Simplektik usul esa fazaviy hajm va invariantlarni $\Delta E/E_0 < 10^{-3}$ darajasida saqlaydi (To'g'ri)
ru: B) В простом Эйлере энергия в каждом кадре искусственно растёт экспоненциально, а симплектический метод сохраняет фазовый объём и инварианты на уровне $\Delta E/E_0 < 10^{-3}$ (верно)
en: B) With plain Euler the energy grows artificially and exponentially every frame, while the symplectic method preserves phase volume and invariants at the $\Delta E/E_0 < 10^{-3}$ level (correct)

s: C) Simplektik usul faqat WebGL da ishlaydi
ru: C) Симплектический метод работает только в WebGL
en: C) The symplectic method only works in WebGL

s: D) Oddiy Eylerda tezlik manfiy bo‘la olmaydi
ru: D) В простом Эйлере скорость не может быть отрицательной
en: D) In plain Euler the velocity cannot be negative

s: Developing the Theory of Formative Assessment
ru: Developing the Theory of Formative Assessment
en: Developing the Theory of Formative Assessment

s: Shakllantiruvchi baholash va uzluksiz qayta aloqa (Formative Feedback) o‘quvchining o‘z xatolarini real vaqt rejimida tushunib, o‘quv faoliyatini to‘g‘rilashiga xizmat qiladi.
ru: Формирующее оценивание и непрерывная обратная связь (Formative Feedback) помогают учащемуся понимать свои ошибки в реальном времени и корректировать учебную деятельность.
en: Formative assessment and continuous feedback help learners understand their mistakes in real time and adjust their learning.

s: Samarali qayta aloqa talabaga 3 ta asosiy savolga javob berishi kerak: "Men qayerga boryapman?", "Hozir qanday ketyapman?" va "Keyingi qadamim qanday bo‘lishi kerak?".
ru: Эффективная обратная связь должна отвечать студенту на 3 основных вопроса: «Куда я иду?», «Как у меня дела сейчас?» и «Каким должен быть мой следующий шаг?».
en: Effective feedback should answer 3 key questions for the student: "Where am I going?", "How am I doing now?" and "What should my next step be?".
